item.description:
Expected status: 200

exec: pm.test("Organizations are returned as an array", () => pm.expect(body).to.be.an("array"));

item.name: API10 PUT /organizations/{{tempOrgId}} - Rename the temporary organization

item.name: 04 - Process Flows
API24 POST /process-flows - Create a process flow
item.description:
Expected status: 201
Expected response: The newly created process flow, including its ID and topology.

item.name: API25 GET /process-flows - List accessible process flows
item.description:
Expected status: 200
Expected response: A JSON array filtered to the viewer's organization.

exec: pm.test("Process flows are returned as an array", () => pm.expect(body).to.be.an("array"));

item.name: API26 GET /process-flows/{{flowId}} - Retrieve one process flow
item.description:
Expected status: 200
Expected response: The requested organization-scoped process flow.

item.name: API27 PUT /process-flows/{{flowId}} - Update a process flow
item.description:
Expected status: 200
Expected response: The updated process flow with its persisted topology.

item.name: API28 POST /process-flows - Prevent a viewer from creating process flows
item.description:
Expected status: 403
Expected response: A JSON authorization error and no new process-flow record.

item.name: 05 - InfluxDB Metadata and Device Permissions
API29 GET /influx/buckets - List InfluxDB buckets
item.description:
Expected status: 200
Expected response: A JSON bucket list from the configured InfluxDB service.

exec: const bucket = typeof value === "string" ? value : value?.name ?? value?.bucket;
pm.test("At least one bucket is available", () => pm.expect(bucket).to.exist);

item.name: API31 GET /influx/measurements?bucket={{bucket}} - List InfluxDB measurements
item.description:
Expected status: 200
Expected response: A JSON measurement list for the selected bucket.

exec: const measurement = typeof value === "string" ? value : value?.name ?? value?.measurement;
pm.test("At least one measurement is available", () => pm.expect(measurement).to.exist);

item.name: API33 GET /influx/ids?bucket={{bucket}}&measurement={{measurement}}&tagKey={{tagKey}} - List identifiers for one measurement
item.description:
Expected status: 200
Expected response: A JSON identifier list filtered by bucket and measurement.

item.description:
Expected status: 201

exec: pm.test("Device assignment ID is returned", () => pm.expect(body.deviceId).to.exist);

item.description:

exec: pm.test("Device assignments are returned as an array", () => pm.expect(body).to.be.an("array"));

item.name: API36 GET /influx/allowed-devices - List devices permitted for the viewer
item.description:

exec: pm.test("Allowed devices are returned as an array", () => pm.expect(body).to.be.an("array"));

item.name: API37 GET /influx/channels?bucket={{bucket}}&measurement={{measurement}}&tagKey={{tagKey}}&tagValue={{deviceId}} - List permitted channels

item.name: 06 - Dashboard Data
API43 POST /template-live-data - Retrieve dashboard live data
item.description:
Expected status: 200
Expected response: Latest permitted industrial measurement data for the requested widget source.

item.name: 07 - Cleanup
API38 DELETE /organization-influx-devices/{{deviceAssignmentId}} - Remove one device permission
item.description:
Expected status: 200
Expected response: A success response confirming removal of the permission row.

item.name: API41 POST /organization-influx-devices - Create a device permission for bulk removal
item.description:
Expected status: 201
Expected response: A temporary permission assignment ID for the bulk-removal test.

exec: pm.test("Cleanup assignment ID is returned", () => pm.expect(body.deviceId).to.exist);

item.name: API42 POST /organization-influx-devices/bulk-remove - Remove a device permission in bulk
item.description:
Expected status: 200
Expected response: A success response confirming that the temporary permission row was removed.

exec: pm.test("One cleanup assignment is removed", () => pm.expect(body.removed).to.eql(1));

item.description:
Expected status: 200

item.name: API47 DELETE /organizations/{{tempOrgId}} - Delete the temporary organization and unlink its user
item.description:
Expected status: 200
Expected response: A success response confirming deletion of the temporary organization; its user is retained with no organization because no user-delete API is exposed.
